afterToolUse.description: POST tool_call NDJSON to local Synapse (adjust base_url and paths)
afterToolUse.command: sh -c 'TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); RUN=${SYNAPSE_RUN_ID:-run_ops}; AGENT=${SYNAPSE_AGENT_ID:-cursor}; TOOL="$CURSOR_TOOL_NAME"; OK=true; curl -sf -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/events/harness_events" -H "content-type: application/x-ndjson" --data-binary "{\"ts\":\"$TS\",\"run_id\":\"$RUN\",\"agent_id\":\"$AGENT\",\"type\":\"tool_call\",\"payload\":{\"name\":\"$TOOL\",\"ok\":$OK}}\n" || true'

_notes: Cursor hook env var names vary by version — substitute the tool name from your hook payload.
Prefer synapse ops mcp when you can: it captures every MCP tools/call automatically.
See docs/OPS.md for Python @tool_call decorator and TypeScript wrapTool().
